paper: Any-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection by Spectral Learning (Karageorgiou, Papadopoulos, Kompatsiaris, Gavves — CVPR 2025)
training_set_in_paper: Self-supervised masked-spectral-learning on REAL images only, then a detector head trained on a single latent-diffusion (LDM) generator vs real. ~180k LDM-generated (256x256, Corvi et al. DMimageDetection 'latent_diffusion_trainingset') + 180k reals (COCO + LSUN); val = 20k+20k. Backbone = MFM-pretrained ViT-B/16 (mfm_pretrain_vit_base.pth). See README Training; configs/spai.yaml TRAIN.EPOCHS 35.

benchmarks.name: SPAI main eval set (13 generators x 5 real sources) — the paper's headline
subsets_or_generators: 13 generators (data/ CSVs): SD-1.3, SD-1.4, SD-2, SD-3, SDXL, Glide, DALLE2, DALLE3, Firefly, Flux, GigaGAN, MidJourney-v5, MidJourney-v6.1. Synthbuster supplies the Glide/SD1.3/SD1.4/SD2/SDXL/DALLE2/DALLE3/Firefly/MidJourney fakes; SD3/MJv6.1/GigaGAN/Flux supplied via authors' GDrive.

paper_number.note: Table 1 headline = ~91.0% mean AUC across 13 generators x 5 real sources; +5.5% absolute AUC over prior SOTA (RINE 85.5). Metric is AUC, not AP/acc.

paper_per_generator.note: Per-generator AUC in Table 1; generators bucketed by resolution: <0.5MP {Glide,SD1.3,SD1.4}, 0.5-1MP {Flux,DALLE2,SD2,SDXL,SD3}, >1MP {GigaGAN,MJv5,MJv6.1,DALLE3,Firefly}. Exact per-cell AUCs in paper Table 1 (not transcribed here to avoid invented digits).

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: ANY-/NATIVE-RESOLUTION. configs/spai.yaml: RESOLUTION_MODE='arbitrary', TEST.ORIGINAL_RESOLUTION=True, MINIMUM_PATCHES=4, REQUIRED_NORMALIZATION='positive_0_1' (no ImageNet norm at dataset side), FEATURE_EXTRACTION_BATCH=400. Each test image is processed at its NATIVE resolution: spai/models/sid.py PatchBasedMFViT.forward_arbitrary_resolution_batch (sid.py:176-237) patchifies the full image into overlapping 224x224 patches (patchify_image, stride=PATCH_STRIDE), runs every patch through the MFM ViT, and aggregates with Spectral Context Attention (patches_attention). If an image yields < MINIMUM_PATCHES(4) patches it falls back to five_crop (sid.py:198-202). NO global resize to a fixed size. Metric = torchmetrics AUROC (spai/metrics.py:56,88-96). Run: `python -m spai test --cfg configs/spai.yaml --opt MODEL.PATCH_VIT.MINIMUM_PATCHES 4 --test-csv <csv>` with --model <epoch>.pth.
benchmarks.gap_cause: (1) Eval set not on disk: Synthbuster + the GDrive SD3/MJv6.1/GigaGAN/Flux + RAISE/FODB/OpenImages/ImageNet/COCO test reals are not staged (only /hddstore/.../spai_train exists). (2) AGID cannot reproduce the protocol: AGID implements ONLY the FIXED-resolution MFViT variant and deliberately omits the any-resolution Spectral Context Attention wrapper (models/image/spai/README.md 'Scope of this implementation', line 180; conf/model/image/spai.yaml patch_size=patch_stride=224 feeding a fixed 448x448 -> 2x2=4-patch grid). AGID eval transform is resize_short_256 + center_crop_224 (README:112), discarding the native high-resolution spectral statistics the paper depends on. AGID also reports mAP/acc, not the paper's AUC.
benchmarks.dataset_source: gated/external. Synthbuster: Zenodo https://zenodo.org/records/10066460 (record 10066460). SD3/MJv6.1/GigaGAN/Flux: authors' GDrive https://drive.google.com/file/d/1no5T89h97TZvAKNCHKt2PQfKZ1UDtbI4/view . Real sources: RAISE-1k (loki.disi.unitn.it/RAISE), FODB (faui1-files.cs.fau.de/.../fodb), Open Images V7, COCO2017 test, ImageNet test (Kaggle ILSVRC). docs/data.md lists all; data/*.csv enumerate the exact files.

benchmarks.name: GenImage (cross-dataset, AGID benchmark)
subsets_or_generators: 8 generators: adm, biggan, glide, midjourney, sdv1.4, sdv1.5, vqdm, wukong

paper_number.note: GenImage is NOT a primary SPAI paper table; it is the AGID cross-reference benchmark. The paper's headline is its own 13-gen/5-real AUC set, not GenImage.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same any-/native-resolution protocol (arbitrary mode, ORIGINAL_RESOLUTION, MINIMUM_PATCHES=4) applied to GenImage 8-gen test; AUROC.

our_number.ckpt: official: repro/ckpts/spai_official.pth (vendored any-res path); AGID best: checkpoints_retrain/spai/model_3.pth

benchmarks.gap_cause: AGID 88.80 vs official-vendored 91.33 = ~2.5 mAP, on adm/midjourney (official adm ap 80.86 / mj 81.41; AGID retrains plateau lower). Root cause = recipe/architecture: AGID's fixed-448 2x2-patch model cannot exploit native-resolution patch statistics, and re-trains on the fixed path (spai_full 77.79, spai_v2 86.20, model_3 88.80) underperform the vendored any-resolution checkpoint, so the shipped 88.80 is kept. The 91.33 'official' number is itself produced by AGID running the VENDORED any-resolution path, not the AGID spai class.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/GenImage_full/test (real source variant) and test_full. Origin: github.com/GenImage-Dataset/GenImage.

benchmarks.name: Synthbuster
subsets_or_generators: 9 generators: Glide, SD-1.3, SD-1.4, SD-2, SDXL, DALLE2, DALLE3, Firefly, MidJourney — paired with RAISE-1k reals

paper_number.note: Synthbuster is the source of most SPAI fake-image generators within the 13-gen Table-1 eval rather than a standalone headline table; per-generator AUCs roll into Table 1.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Native-resolution arbitrary mode; AUROC. data/fake_*.csv (fake_sd13, fake_sd14, fake_sd2, fake_sdxl, fake_glide, fake_dalle2, fake_dalle3, fake_firefly, fake_mjv5) point into the Synthbuster directory; reals from data/real_raise.csv.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Synthbuster archive not on disk (no /hddstore/.../Synthbuster). Must be fetched from Zenodo 10066460 and placed under spai_official/data per docs/data.md before the CSV-driven eval can run. AGID also lacks the any-resolution path to run it faithfully.
